findings.where: Install section cards 'Claude Code', 'Codex', 'Pi', 'GitHub Copilot' and 'Factory Droid', 1440, motion/t4-normal-600.png y 460-735
findings.evidence: The command lines stop at the card's right edge with no wrap, fade or scroll: '/plugin marketplace add cathrynlavery/diagram-de', 'codex plugin marketplace add cathrynlavery/diagr', 'pi install https://github.com/cathrynlavery/diag' and 'droid plugin install diagram-design@diagram-desi'.
findings.before: Five of the seven install commands are cut mid-word inside their cards.
findings.after: Each command wraps at a path separator or scrolls inside its code line, so the full command can be read before it is copied.
findings.why: A visitor who reads before pasting, or copies by hand, cannot see what the command will run.
findings.root: the install card's code line (white-space: nowrap with overflow hidden)
